roleNote: Devoted maid support in duos. Oni Rem is a strong Water/Blood physical attacker.

name: Spike Spiegel

learn.why: Off-type (Wind): his fighter ship.

abilities.name: Jeet Kune Do
abilities.text: His quick (priority) moves do 1.3x.

abilities.name: Bounty Hunter
abilities.text: His moves do 1.5x against foes below half Vitality.

abilities.name: Just a Dream
abilities.text: Once per battle, a hit that would knock him out leaves him at 1 Vitality.

roleNote: Fast gunman. Jeet Kune Do makes his quick moves hit harder, and Bounty Hunter finishes weakened foes.

name: Anya

learn.why: Off-type (Light): her begging face.

abilities.name: Mind Reader
abilities.text: Her Protect-style moves never fail when used in a row.

abilities.name: Waku Waku
abilities.text: Her Speed rises by 1 when she enters battle.

abilities.name: Heh
abilities.text: When she enters battle, her smug face lowers foes' Will by 1.

roleNote: Mind reader: her signature copies the foe's move and uses it first. Mind Reader lets her Protect every turn.

name: Yor

abilities.name: Thorn Princess
abilities.text: Her contact moves have a 30% chance to cause Bleed.

abilities.name: Deadly Cooking
abilities.text: Healing moves she uses on allies also cause Bleed (her food is lethal).

abilities.name: Mama!
abilities.text: Duos: when Anya is her ally, her Power rises by 1 on entry and Anya takes 1/4 less damage. Rare pair bonus.

roleNote: Fast assassin: Thorn Princess spreads Bleed on contact. Deadly Cooking is a gag downside. Hidden pair bonus with Anya.

name: Sukuna

abilities.name: King of Curses
abilities.text: When he enters battle, foes' Will drops by 1.

abilities.name: Reverse Cursed Technique
abilities.text: He heals 1/8 each turn.

abilities.name: Four Arms
abilities.text: His contact moves hit twice: the second hit does 1/4 damage.

roleNote: King of Curses: hits twice on contact, regenerates, and his domain chips the whole foe side for 3 turns.

name: Aizen

learn.why: Off-type (Time): he planned this for a hundred years.

abilities.name: Kyoka Suigetsu
abilities.text: The first time he enters battle, all foes are Confused. Once you have seen his Shikai, the illusion is already set.

abilities.name: Hogyoku
abilities.text: After a super-effective hit, he takes half damage from that type for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: All According to Plan
abilities.text: His first move each turn goes last but does 1.5x. Everything was part of his plan.

roleNote: Hypnosis: confuses every foe on entry. Hogyoku adapts to the type that hit him. All According to Plan moves last on purpose for 1.5x.

name: Muzan

abilities.name: Demon King
abilities.text: He heals 1/8 each turn and can't be Bled.

abilities.name: Coward
abilities.text: When he drops below 1/4 Vitality, he switches out by himself. He splits into pieces and runs.

abilities.name: Blood Mixing
abilities.text: His contact moves have a 30% chance to Bleed.

roleNote: Spread attacker that runs away: Coward pulls him out at 1/4 so he lives to come back. Bleed spreader.

name: Frieza

abilities.name: Ruthless
abilities.text: His moves do 1.3x against foes below half Vitality.

abilities.name: Four Months of Training
abilities.text: After his fourth turn in battle, all his stats rise by 1. He only trained a bit (gag).

abilities.name: Survivor
abilities.text: If he is at full Vitality, a hit that would knock him out leaves him at 1. He always comes back.

roleNote: Cruel cleaner: priority Death Beam picks off weakened foes, Ruthless boosts damage on them. Gets stronger after 4 turns.

name: Kaido

learn.why: Off-type (Dark): a dragon's jaws.

abilities.name: Strongest Creature
abilities.text: At full Vitality he takes 0.75x damage, and a hit that would knock him out leaves him at 1.

abilities.name: Drunk
abilities.text: Each turn there is a 30% chance he gets Confused, and each time his Power rises by 1 (gag).

abilities.name: Thunder Bagua
abilities.text: His physical moves do 1.2x and have a 10% chance to Stun.

roleNote: Strongest creature: tanky, can't be one-shot, spread fire breath. Drunk is a gag that makes him unpredictable but stronger.

name: Whitebeard

abilities.name: Strongest Man
abilities.text: If he is at full Vitality, a hit that would knock him out leaves him at 1.

abilities.name: Pops
abilities.text: When an ally is knocked out, his Power rises by 2.

abilities.name: Died Standing
abilities.text: When he is knocked out, the foe that did it loses 1/4 of its max Vitality.

roleNote: Team dad: Power +2 when an ally falls, spread quake that drops Guard, and punishes whoever knocks him out.

name: Shigaraki

abilities.name: Decay
abilities.text: Foes he hits with contact moves lose 1/8 of their max Vitality each turn after.

abilities.name: All For One
abilities.text: When his move knocks out a foe, he takes its ability for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Rage
abilities.text: The first time he drops below half Vitality, his Power rises by 2.

roleNote: Decay spreader: contact moves rot foes each turn, and he takes the ability of anything he knocks out.

name: Obito

learn.why: Off-type (Cosmic): slipping into the Kamui dimension.
Off-type (Cosmic): slipping into the Kamui dimension.

abilities.name: Kamui
abilities.text: The first hit aimed at him each time he enters battle passes through him.

abilities.name: Sharingan
abilities.text: He knows the foe's moves and his moves can't miss.

abilities.name: Izanagi
abilities.text: The first time he is knocked out, he comes back with half his max Vitality.

roleNote: Untouchable in the first form (Kamui dodge every entry), comes back once with Izanagi. Ten-Tails form is a slow nuke.

name: Hisoka

abilities.name: Bungee Gum
abilities.text: After he hits a foe with a contact move, it can't switch out.

abilities.name: Texture Surprise
abilities.text: The first damaging hit he takes each battle hits a fake instead.

abilities.name: Ripe Fruit
abilities.text: His moves do 1.3x against foes with raised stats.

roleNote: Trapper and mind-game: Bungee Gum sticks the target, it can't leave. Hits harder against boosted foes, so he punishes setup.

name: Makima

abilities.name: Control Devil
abilities.text: Foes below half Vitality can't switch out. They are her dogs.

abilities.name: Contract
abilities.text: The first hit that would knock her out each battle does nothing. The damage goes to someone else.

abilities.name: Bang
abilities.text: Her signature ignores Protect and Substitute.

roleNote: Controller with a spread nuke. Foes below half can't leave; Contract cancels the first knockout. Bang ignores Protect.

name: Mahito

learn.why: Off-type (Beast): turning his body into monster parts.

abilities.name: Soul Shape
abilities.text: Non-Spirit physical moves do half damage to him. Only hits to the soul hurt.

abilities.name: Transfigured Humans
abilities.text: When he enters battle, a transfigured human takes the first hit (a decoy with 1/8 of his max Vitality).

abilities.name: Instant Domain
abilities.text: His first contact move after entering can't miss and ignores Guard.

roleNote: Ability-breaker: his signature replaces the target's ability with nothing. Takes less from non-Spirit physical hits.

name: Yamcha

learn.why: Off-type (Dark): fights like a wild wolf.

abilities.name: Desert Bandit
abilities.text: When he knocks out a foe, his Speed rises by 1.

abilities.name: Baseball Star
abilities.text: Thrown and shot moves (like Spirit Ball) do 1.3x.

abilities.name: Saibaman Blast
abilities.text: When he faints from a hit, the attacker loses 1/4 of its max Vitality.

roleNote: Gag fighter. Wolf Fang Fist is a five-hit move that breaks Substitutes and Sturdy. Hidden Saibaman Blast punishes whoever knocks him out.

name: Mr. Satan

abilities.name: Takes the Credit
abilities.text: When an ally knocks out a foe, his Power rises by 1.

abilities.name: Crowd Favourite
abilities.text: Duos: when he enters, his ally heals 1/8 of its max Vitality.

abilities.name: Illusion of Strength
abilities.text: Enters battle disguised as the last ally in the party until hit.

roleNote: Fake champion. Illusion disguise and Takes the Credit (power from allies' knockouts) make a gag back-line cleaner. Weakest stats in his tier on purpose.

name: Mumen Rider

abilities.name: Never Give Up
abilities.text: At full Vitality, he survives any single hit with at least 1.

abilities.name: Unwavering Heart
abilities.text: Can't flinch and his Speed can't be lowered.

abilities.name: Hero to the Crowd
abilities.text: When he faints, the ally that replaces him gets +1 Power and +1 Energy.

roleNote: Duos redirector: Follow Me plus Never Give Up keeps him standing to soak hits. Hero to the Crowd makes his faint a buff, and Justice Crash punishes anyone who leaves him at low Vitality.

name: Murata

abilities.name: Survivor
abilities.text: At full Vitality, he survives any single hit with at least 1.

abilities.name: Water Breathing (Weak)
abilities.text: Below 1/3 Vitality, his Water moves do 1.3x.

abilities.name: Hashira Report
abilities.text: When he switches out, the ally coming in gets +1 Speed.

roleNote: Background slayer: weak but survives. Never Dies (Sturdy) plus a self-buffing signature makes him a scrappy early-game pick that falls off.

name: Koby

learn.why: Off-type (Tech): Rokushiki's Iron Body hardens him like steel.

abilities.name: Crybaby Resolve
abilities.text: When a foe lowers one of his stats, his Power rises by 2.

abilities.name: Observation Haki
abilities.text: The first hit he takes each battle does half damage.

abilities.name: Rokushiki
abilities.text: His quick (priority) moves do 1.3x.

roleNote: Growth niche: crybaby who gets strong when pushed. Defiant punishes stat drops, and Honesty Impact is a heavy hitter far above his tier.

name: Hanataro

abilities.name: Fourth Division Medic
abilities.text: Duos: each turn, 30% chance to cure his ally's status.

abilities.name: Sewer Guide
abilities.text: Can always switch out, even when trapped. He knows every tunnel under the Seireitei.

abilities.name: Senkaimaru
abilities.text: After he heals with a move, his next attacking move does 2x.

roleNote: Healer and screen setter. The hidden ability Senkaimaru turns stored healing into one huge hit, so an "attacking Hanataro" build exists for surprise.

name: Kon

learn.why: Off-type (Wind): leaps between walls with his mod soul legs.

abilities.name: Mod Soul Legs
abilities.text: Kicking moves do 1.3x.

abilities.name: Plushie Body
abilities.text: Contact moves do half damage to him, but Fire moves do double.

abilities.name: Borrowed Body
abilities.text: When he enters battle he transforms into the foe in front of him.

roleNote: Plushie body halves contact damage (but Fire hurts double). Hidden Borrowed Body copies the foe on entry, like Ditto.

name: Happy

abilities.name: Aera
abilities.text: Immune to Earth moves. He flies on magic wings.

abilities.name: Aye Sir!
abilities.text: Duos: when he enters, his ally's Speed rises by 1.

abilities.name: Fish Stash
abilities.text: The first time he drops below half Vitality he eats a fish and heals 1/4.

roleNote: Fast duos support: Aye Sir! speeds up his ally and Max Speed is a strong priority hit for his tier. Levitate dodges Earth.

name: Konohamaru

learn.why: Off-type (Light): his famous transformation gag.

abilities.name: Will of Fire
abilities.text: Below 1/3 Vitality, his own-type moves do 1.5x.

abilities.name: Stubborn Kid
abilities.text: Can't be Confused or Taunted.

abilities.name: Shadow Clone
abilities.text: The first time he drops below half Vitality, a clone appears and takes hits for him (a 1/4 Substitute).

roleNote: Kid ninja with a real Rasengan. Shadow Clone hidden ability makes a free decoy, and the gag Sexy Jutsu (Charm) is a legit Power drop.

name: Mineta

abilities.name: Pop Off
abilities.text: A foe that hits him with a Physical move loses 1 Speed. His head is covered in sticky balls.

abilities.name: Stuck Fast
abilities.text: He can't be forced to switch out. He sticks himself in place with his balls.

abilities.name: Cowardice
abilities.text: Switches out by himself when he drops below half Vitality.

roleNote: Hazard lead. Sticky Web plus Grape Rush and Pop Off slow the whole enemy team, which lets slow hard hitters move first. Cowardice (hidden) turns him into a free switch for a teammate.
